title: LevelRisk
description: Contract for the Stage 1 Brain Completion Batch — level/gradient risk rule. Contract version 1.0.0, same convention as Slices 1-5. Canonical source of truth: this file, in Project-Check-Brain.

LevelInput.description: The raw p.facts.level value. Exact match against 'No' or 'Not sure' only. 'Yes', the legacy pre-27-Aug string 'No / gradient present' (deliberately NOT matched — see level-risk.js's known_behavioural_nuance comment), empty string, null, undefined, and any other unrecognised value must all produce a null output.

RiskOutput.description: The risk this rule contributes to p.risks1, or null when level is neither 'No' nor 'Not sure'.

text.const: Levels may affect base design, drainage, thresholds and installation.
